test_maybe_get_tz: test the timezones.maybe_get_tz function to retrieve timezone objects from strings, pytz, dateutil, or UTC offsets
test_is_utc: test the timezones.is_utc function to verify whether a timezone object represents UTC
test_tz_compare: test the timezones.tz_compare function to compare two timezone objects for equality
test_infer_tzinfo: test the timezones.infer_tzinfo function to infer timezone info from two datetime inputs
test_tz_cache_keys: test the timezones._p_tz_cache_key function to ensure pytz and dateutil timezone cache keys are distinct
